_note: Declarative source of truth for what workflows we expect to be enabled in litentry/projects/19. The check-workflows.sh script audits the live state against this. NOTE: GitHub's public API does NOT expose the filter expression or action configuration of each workflow — only names + enabled state. Filter/action contents must still be verified in the web UI.

expected.name: Auto-add to project
expected.verify_in_ui: Filter expression should be: `repo:litentry/agentKeys is:issue` (or `is:issue,pr is:open` if you also want PRs). Without this filter, the workflow won't pull from the right source.
expected.purpose: Auto-adds new issues from the agentKeys repo to the project board so engineers don't need to run add-to-project.sh manually.

expected.name: Auto-add sub-issues to project
expected.verify_in_ui: No filter needed; should inherit from parent issue's project.
expected.purpose: Sub-issues of an already-tracked parent get auto-added.

expected.name: Item added to project
expected.verify_in_ui: Action should be: Set Status → Todo (or Backlog if you prefer).
expected.purpose: Sets initial workflow state when an item lands on the board.

expected.name: Item closed
expected.verify_in_ui: Action should be: Set Status → Done.
expected.purpose: When an issue is closed in the repo, the project item auto-moves to Done.

expected.name: Auto-close issue
expected.verify_in_ui: Trigger: Status is updated to Done. Action: Close the issue.
expected.purpose: When a project item's Status is set to Done in the board, the underlying GitHub issue auto-closes.

expected.name: Pull request linked to issue
expected.verify_in_ui: No filter needed; uses GitHub's built-in 'Closes #N' / 'Fixes #N' / 'Resolves #N' detection.
expected.purpose: Auto-links a PR to the issue it closes.

expected.name: Pull request merged
expected.verify_in_ui: Action should be: Set linked issue Status → Done.
expected.purpose: When a PR merges, the linked issue's project item auto-moves to Done (which then triggers Auto-close issue to close the issue itself).

expected.name: Auto-archive items
expected._note_on_should_be_enabled: Recommend enabling with 30-day threshold to keep the board lean, but not strictly required. Setting should_be_enabled=false here means the check script won't flag it as missing; flip to true once you've enabled it.
expected.purpose: Auto-archives items 30+ days in Done; keeps active views uncluttered.

expected.name: Code review approved
expected._note_on_should_be_enabled: Optional. Enable if you have a 'Ready to merge' status in your workflow.
expected.verify_in_ui: Trigger: PR review approved. Action: Set Status → Ready to merge.
expected.purpose: Visual signal that a PR is review-clean and ready to land.

expected.name: Code changes requested
expected.verify_in_ui: Trigger: PR review = changes requested. Action: Set Status → In Progress.
expected.purpose: Moves a PR back to In Progress when reviewer requests changes.

expected.name: Item reopened
expected.verify_in_ui: Trigger: closed item is reopened. Action: Set Status → Todo.
expected.purpose: Resets workflow state when a closed item is reopened.
